PART - I
1. RATE: RGP
1.1. FIXED CHARGES / MONTH
(a) Up to and including 2 kW ... Rs. 15/- per month
(b) Above 2 kW to 4 kW ... Rs. 25/- per month
(c) Above 4 kW to 6 kW ... Rs. 45/- per month
(d) Above 6 kW ... Rs. 70/- per month
PLUS
1.2. ENERGY CHARGES
                       Post-Paid Energy Charge   Pre-paid Energy Charge
(a) First 50 units      305 Paise per Unit        296 Paise per Unit
(b) Next 50 Units       350 Paise per Unit        340 Paise per Unit
(c) Next 150 Units      415 Paise per Unit        403 Paise per Unit
(d) Above 250 Units     520 Paise per Unit        504 Paise per Unit
1.3. BPL CONSUMERS
(a) First 50 units ... 150 Paise per Unit
(b) Above 50 units ... Rate as per RGP
1.4. TIME OF USE DISCOUNT
Consumers with smart meters shall get a concession of 60 Paise per Unit for consumption between 11:00 hrs to 17:00 hrs.
1.5. MINIMUM BILL
The minimum bill shall be the fixed charge as per clause 1.1.
8. RATE: AG
8.1.1 HP BASED TARIFF
Rs. 200 per HP per month
ALTERNATIVELY
8.1.2 METERED TARIFF
(a) Fixed charge ... Rs. 20 per HP per month
PLUS
(b) Energy charge ... 60 Paise per Unit
ALTERNATIVELY
8.1.3 TATKAL SCHEME
(a) Fixed charge ... Rs. 20 per HP per month
PLUS
(b) Energy charge ... 80 Paise per Unit
The Tatkal tariff shall revert to the metered tariff after five years.
8.2. BRICK MANUFACTURING
Rs. 1800 per annum per kW subject to a minimum of Rs. 5400 per annum
11. RATE: HTP-1
11.1. DEMAND CHARGE
11.1.1. For billing demand up to contract demand
(a) For the first 500 kVA of billing demand ... Rs. 150/- per kVA per month
(b) For the next 500 kVA of billing demand ... Rs. 250/- per kVA per month
(c) For billing demand in excess of 1000 kVA ... Rs. 400/- per kVA per month
11.1.2. For billing demand in excess of the contract demand ... Rs. 555 per kVA per month
PLUS
11.2. ENERGY CHARGES
(a) Up to 500 kVA ... 400 Paise per Unit
(b) above 500 up to 2500 kVA ... 420 Paise per Unit
(c) above 2500 kVA ... 430 Paise per Unit
11.3. TIME OF USE CHARGES
(a) Up to 500 kVA ... 45 Paise per Unit for consumption between 07:00 to 11:00 hrs and 18:00 to 22:00 hrs
(b) above 500 kVA ... 85 Paise per Unit
11.4. BILLING DEMAND
The billing demand shall be the highest of the actual maximum demand, 85% of the contract demand and 100 kVA.
11.5. POWER FACTOR ADJUSTMENT CHARGES
(a) Penalty of 1% of the energy charge bill for every 1% fall below 90% down to 85%
(b) Rebate of 0.5% of the energy charge bill for every 1% rise above 95%
